suite: v15 production app + touch + core + rules + game + progression input integration
scope: Actual six production modules in fresh Node VMs. DOM event/capture, renderer/scene/audio and scheduling fixtures only. No browser layout, WebGL, real Android, or content:// validation.

results.name: All six production modules initialize against the shipped v15 DOM contract
Class selector starts the actual fighter kit and matching skills
Class selector starts the actual ranger kit and matching skills
Class selector starts the actual wizard kit and matching skills
WASD moves in camera-relative directions without rotating the camera
Diagonal keyboard movement is normalized to the same forward speed
Shift slows to walking and Ctrl crouches; neither activates a class skill
Q activates Fighter Sprint, E consumes Second Wind once, key repeat does not retrigger
Ranger Q is Back Step and E is timed Field Ration, with class-specific charges
F hold searches, release cancels, completed hold opens loot; Tab toggles inventory
Old I/H bindings do not open the bag or consume a potion
X sheath changes equipment state, G rests within recoverable HP, movement wakes
1/2 select weapon sets and 3/4 select utilities; a potion requires a timed primary action
Space jumps and R reloads the selected crossbow using reserve ammunition
Typing into home fields does not leak WASD or action key input into the game
Captured mouse moves yaw/pitch, clamps pitch, and ignores movement after pause
A desktop canvas click first captures the mouse without making an accidental attack
Arrow-key look defaults off and only the explicit web option enables it
Pointer Lock throw enables arrow fallback without pausing gameplay
Pointer Lock reject enables arrow fallback without pausing gameplay
Pointer Lock missing enables arrow fallback without pausing gameplay
Pointer-lock error fallback is cleared after a successful capture
Unexpected Pointer Lock loss pauses and clears held mouse and keyboard input
First touch enables a hybrid device without discarding a held keyboard move
Joystick dead zone, proportional movement and oversized diagonal clamping use actual input
A second movement or look pointer cannot steal or release the original owner
Move, look and attack work concurrently and release independently
Unknown pointer motion cannot look; owned look clamps vertical rotation
A second secondary-action finger cannot cancel the first finger shield hold
Pointer cancellation and lost capture clear only the matching pointer record
Touch movement release preserves a held keyboard direction
F search held by keyboard and touch continues until the final keyboard release
F search held by keyboard and touch continues until the final touch release
Walk, crouch and jump touch holds feed distinct stance inputs
Pause and inventory screen transitions cancel all held controls and restore neutral input
resize clears controls and stale touch events cannot resume movement
orientationchange clears controls and stale touch events cannot resume movement
blur clears controls and stale touch events cannot resume movement
Hidden document pauses and restart discards all pointers from the previous run
Touch mode off resets held input, on re-enables it, and invalid values do not replace mode
touch bow: early release cancels; fully drawn hold fires exactly once on release
mouse bow: early release cancels; fully drawn hold fires exactly once on release
Ready bow pointercancel cancellation never fires or spends ammunition
Ready bow lostpointercapture cancellation never fires or spends ammunition
Ready bow blur cancellation never fires or spends ammunition
Ready bow inventory cancellation never fires or spends ammunition
Ready bow pause cancellation never fires or spends ammunition
Mixed mouse/touch bow ownership preserves draw until the final normal release
Cancelling a secondary touch must preserve the mouse-owned ready bow draw
Keyboard Q spell picker selects by hover and releases without pausing dungeon time
Spell picker number keys choose spells instead of changing weapon sets or utilities
Touch skill opens spell picker, cancels movement, and a choice restores neutral controls
touch spell: early release does not spend a charge, ready release casts once
mouse spell: early release does not spend a charge, ready release casts once
Ready spell pointercancel cancellation never casts or spends a charge
Ready spell lostpointercapture cancellation never casts or spends a charge
Ready spell blur cancellation never casts or spends a charge
Ready spell inventory cancellation never casts or spends a charge

Wizard E meditation restores spent charges and movement interrupts the channel
Pointer compatibility click cannot double-activate a physical touch attack
Synthetic click on a hold-only touch button is ignored, while discrete buttons remain keyboard-activatable
Cancelling touch primary preserves an independently held touch shield
Cancelled touch primary hands the shared bow hold back to its mouse owner
Cancelled touch secondary hands the shared spell hold back to its mouse owner
Keyboard R dispatches an axe special attack and cancels a prepared Wizard spell
Full-run F extraction retains real loot and only explicit stash sale turns its value into gold
Stash selection feeds the next real loadout; departure withdraws once and death loses that gear
Training never withdraws selected stored gear and does not change extraction statistics
Reloaded pending departure is forfeited once and cannot duplicate withdrawn equipment
